How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
Every ROAM suitcase is made to order and hand-assembled in our Vidalia, Georgia workshop. Production typically takes 4–6 business days.
Once your case is crafted and leaves our workshop, standard ground delivery takes another 4–6 business days. You will receive a tracking email as soon as your order ships so you can follow its journey to your door.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
